title: Jesus... Why Do I Feel Like A Fraud On My First Day?
topic: impostor fear the night before his first day at a new job

bible.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I start the new job tomorrow. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone congratulated me. But I keep thinking they'll find out in week one that I'm not good enough.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You stayed up past midnight reading their docs like exam notes. Why do you think I led you there?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if they ask something I can't answer and I just freeze?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You will. Then you'll say the most senior words in any room: let me check and get back to you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But everyone there looks like they belong. I look like I walked in with a fake badge.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They all had a first day. Every one of them didn't know where the cups were either.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just don't want my first impression to be the wrong one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It's already done. They chose you from everyone who applied. Tomorrow you walk in as the person they picked.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Walk in slowly. I already went ahead of you and saved your seat.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What do you fear they'll find out? 🙏
